name: mindwire-monorepo
description: Make your product AI-powered without rebuilding the agent layer. White-label and customize leading agents with an open-source SDK and runtime.

scripts.build: bun --filter='mindwire' run build && bun --filter='@mindwire/web' run build && bun --filter='@mindwire/console' run build
scripts.preview: bun --filter='@mindwire/web' run build && bun --filter='@mindwire/web' run serve
scripts.test: bun run build:sdk && bun --filter='mindwire' run test
scripts.typecheck: bun --filter='mindwire' run build && bun --filter='mindwire' run typecheck && bun --filter='@mindwire/web' run check && bun --filter='@mindwire/console' run check
